findings.description: Preserve the earlier A04 conflict: target-specific investigation without automatic adoption versus the inherited adopted-to-proceed Premise formula. Primary target slice and inherited comparison remain separate, not owner-resolved precedence.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner must issue an attributable versioned source-precedence/correspondence decision.

findings.description: Definition artifact, contextual proposition-role instance and proposition are different layers. Hypothesis and Premise have distinct normalized identities despite common source lineage and aliases. Abstract role accessors do not select a stored carrier.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and selected carrier owners must confirm the exact layer and role-context mapping.

findings.description: Typical low veracity and often high conviction are not universal classical constraints. Hedge markers belong to candidate-axiom classification in an exact workflow. Unestablished is not actually false; high conviction does not establish truth or promotion.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner must bind qualitative/typical status and hedge-routing semantics separately from source labels.

findings.description: Investigation/experiment and support/refine/reject use inclusive alternatives. Could-response predicates are static primitive conditions, not a modal possibility proof, executed experiment or generic falsifiability verifier.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and Experiment Design and Observation owners must confirm test conditions, falsifiability and evidence-response contracts.

findings.description: Evidence-gated promote/revise/retire describes lifecycle and authority behavior. Static role comparisons do not establish guards, reachable states, preserved consumers, liveness or actual owner promotion.
findings.owner_route: role:definition-owner and Authority Promotion owner must select transition, evidence and stopping/demotion contracts.
